title: Vertex values after appending gates
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $gs$ and $ext$ be lists of gates, and let $x$ be an assignment of Boolean values to the $n$ inputs. For any vertex $v<n+|gs|$, its value after applying $gs$ followed by $ext$ to $x$ equals its value after applying $gs$ to $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ assigns a Boolean value to each of the $n$ inputs
